notes.glasses: Glasses must not cause glare or obscure eyes. Tinted lenses not allowed.
notes.smile: Neutral facial expression with mouth closed and eyes open looking straight.
notes.ears: Eyebrows and eyes must not be covered by hair or headgear.
notes.shadows: Even lighting with sharp focus and no shadow on face or plain white background.
notes.babyRules: Infants: eyes must be open, looking towards camera. No support hands or props visible.
